gap.$description: Gap between carousel slides and between the viewport and the controls.

radius.$description: Corner radius shared by the carousel viewport and slide surfaces.

preview-min-inline-size.$description: Minimum inline size of a decorative carousel preview when space permits.

full-screen-block-size.$description: Block size of the vertical carousel viewport.

control-bg.$description: Surface of the carousel navigation and rotation controls.

control-fg.$description: Text and glyph ink against the carousel control surface.

control-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the carousel control background color.

control-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete optional backdrop filter for the carousel controls.

control-shadow.$description: Resting elevation of the carousel controls.

control-radius.$description: Corner radius of the carousel controls.

control-border.$description: Visible control boundary against the surrounding surface.

control-size.$description: Resting carousel control size before applying the density target floor.

control-icon-size.$description: Glyph size in the carousel navigation controls.
